correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs the exact residual-function equivalence from all suffix lengths and the finite carry-offset set, counts dyadic fingerprints via isolated run-parity bits with a free global Thue–Morse parity, derives exact floor/ceiling maps for the successor offsets, and proves the even/odd fingerprint images disjoint by forbidding constant triples. It solves the recurrence for every integer \(k\ge1\). The standalone checker verifies exhaustive possible fingerprints for \(1\le k\le8\), all parity partitions, and sampled residual equivalence for c=1..40; finite evidence does not replace the infinite proof.

originality.rationale: Inspected the primary full-text Section 4.2 and general exact-formula open problem in arXiv:2512.10017v5; inspected the full mathematical Typst source of Biswas 2026 and OEIS A382296. The main result is an infinite exact successor-dyadic state count and a new disjoint parity-residual recurrence, neither implied solely by the examined dyadic formula or tabulated finite values. Public record searches and indexed semantic searches using exact shifts, aliases and Fibonacci parameters found no covering claim. An unindexed equivalent result remains a risk.
residual_risks: Semantic and public searches may miss an unindexed or differently worded all-shift formula, including in a thesis not inspected in full.
OEIS already contains numeric successor-dyadic instances; only the quantified infinite identity and its structural proof are new within examined evidence.
